transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. ...Well, I suppose I'm here because I just can't seem to shake a certain feeling lately. Even on my better days. 

It's just... well, at my church, and in my walking club. I get the sense that some of the people are watching me. And... I don't know, maybe putting little messages about me in the Sunday bulletin. Or hiding things in what they say when I'm around. I didn't really want to make a big fuss about it, but... well, that's why I came in.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?

Well... I'm not really sure what other people hear. But... sometimes, when the house is very quiet, I suppose I do hear something. 

Just my name, usually. Or a few words. It... it sounds exactly like my friend's voice, coming from the kitchen, or maybe out on the porch. It sounds clear enough that I've actually answered back a few times... just before I remember that nobody else is in the house with me. But that's all it is.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts about your church members and hearing these voices?

Well... I suppose... it's been going on for a while now. Maybe... about eleven months, if I had to guess. The... the things in the bulletin, and the voices. And sometimes I just have trouble keeping my thoughts straight. But... yes, around eleven months.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood was extremely high or low for a significant amount of time, alongside these other experiences?

Well... I suppose there have been some low times. 

A while back, I... I just felt so very down. I wasn't eating much at all. I just felt like I had... failed everyone, I guess. It was hard to get through the day. And... yes, during that same time, I was still hearing my friend's voice in the house. And... I still felt like the people at church were putting those messages in the bulletin. It was all happening together.

During these past eleven months, have there been any periods where you felt your mood was relatively normal, yet you were still experiencing these thoughts about the church members and hearing your friend's voice?

Well... yes, I suppose so. There was a spell of several weeks where... I wasn't feeling quite so weighed down. I was getting dressed, eating a bit better. 

But... the other things didn't stop. I still heard my name in the house. And... I still thought the people at church were hinting about me. So... yes.

During these past eleven months, have you ever experienced a period of several days or longer where you felt unusually energetic, didn't need much sleep, or felt so 'up' that your behavior was different from your usual self?
No... no, I haven't. I'm not really... I don't get energetic like that. I just... I haven't felt that way.
Aside from the times you felt down, have you found it difficult to initiate tasks, take pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or feel motivated to interact with others?

Well... yes. I suppose so. 

I used to... I used to love my garden. And I'd quilt, or read a bit before bed. But... I don't really do that anymore. The quilt basket just sits there. And the weeds... well, they just grow. I don't really care much to stop them. It's just... hard to find the energy for it.
Looking back over the entire eleven months, would you say that the periods where you felt very down took up the majority of that time, or were they just shorter episodes that happened occasionally?

Well... I suppose it's been most of the time. 

For this whole stretch, really. The... the sadness, and feeling guilty about things. Just not caring much. It's mostly just stayed there in the background. Even... even when the voices or the things with the church were a bit quieter... the down feeling didn't really go away.
